questions.stem: A 30-year-old lady presents to the OPD with headache, backache, and abdominal pain for 1 month. On examination, there are multiple scars on the abdomen. The patient is keen on knowing the diagnosis and insists on getting some more tests and procedures. The history she gave was quite long and confusing, consisting of visits to multiple doctors and numerous procedures. What is the most likely diagnosis?
